mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 60 degrees. The moon is a waxing gibbous, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Regarding city news, please note that City Hall will be closed November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving. Additionally, the Public Works department is planning an expansion to accommodate our growing population, and construction continues on Mark Drive.
There is a great lineup of local entertainment. Live music is at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, Wisconsin Brewing Company features music tomorrow, and Paddy Mac's has a show tomorrow evening.
In our weekly police report, on November 4, a 34-year-old woman was arrested for O W I in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue while a minor was in the vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The store is currently open and will be serving customers until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a scoop.
